name: Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Tall, fluffy weekend pancakes. The batter comes together in five minutes.

ingredients.note: melted, plus more for the pan

instructions: Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk the buttermilk and eggs, then whisk in the melted butter.

instructions.text: Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir gently until just combined. Lumps are good; overmixing makes tough pancakes. Let the batter rest for 5 minutes.

instructions: Heat a skillet or griddle over medium heat and brush with butter. Pour ¼ cup (60 ml) of batter per pancake.

instructions.text: Cook until bubbles form on top and the edges look set, 2–3 minutes. Flip and cook until golden, 1–2 minutes more.

tips: No buttermilk? Stir 2 Tbsp lemon juice or vinegar into 2 cups (475 ml) of milk and let it sit for 5 minutes.
Keep finished pancakes warm on a rack in a 200°F (95°C) oven while you cook the rest.
Add blueberries or chocolate chips by scattering them on each pancake right after pouring, not into the bowl.
